newsitem.title: USA: United Tech says judge rules in its favor.
newsitem.headline: United Tech says judge rules in its favor.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said Monday that a Texas State Court judge in an antitrust case between its Pratt & Whitney unit and Chromalloy Gas Turbine Corp, a unit of Sequa Corp, ruled in favor of Pratt & Whitney.

The judgement follows a trial in which a jury rejected Chromalloy's claim that it suffered compensable monetary damages as a result of Pratt & Whitney's alleged monopolization of the jet engine repair market, United Technologies said.
The court denied Pratt & Whitney any relief on its counter-claims, said Sequa in-house counsel Steven Lowson.
"We will promptly appeal today's ruling on Chromalloy's request for injunctive relief," Lowson said.
